meta.title: Marvel Nexus — Infinity Stones
meta.note: Every stone's journey across the Sacred Timeline, traced title by title. Canonical to the Infinity Saga.

appearances.note: Red Skull seizes it in Tønsberg; it swallows him and vanishes beneath the ice.
Project PEGASUS studies it; Goose swallows it and Carol quips it out.
Loki opens the Chitauri portal above New York; Thor carries it home to Asgard.
Loki pockets it from Odin's vault as Asgard burns.
Thanos crushes the Tesseract and claims the Space Stone.
The 1970 Time Heist recovers it; Captain America returns it.
Jane Foster is infected by the Aether; Malekith drains it from her.
Kept safe with the Collector at Knowhere — until he isn't.
Thanos turns it to mist and takes it from the Collector.
Rocket and Thor pull it from a 2013 Jane during the Heist.
Star-Lord steals the Orb on Morag; the Guardians end a dance-off with it.
Entrusted to the Nova Corps on Xandar.
Thanos rips Xandar apart to claim it.
Nebula and Rhodey lift it from 2014 Morag.
Loki's scepter — the mind behind the Chitauri.
Strucker's experiments; Ultron grafts it into Vision's brow.
Powering Vision; a threat even he can't always contain.
Wanda destroys it; Thanos rewinds time and tears it out.
Reclaimed from 2012 New York and returned by Captain America.
Strange studies the Eye; he breaks Dormammu with a time loop.
Strange trades it for Tony Stark — out of 14,000,605 futures.
The Ancient One loans it to Banner; Captain America returns it.
Thanos sacrifices Gamora on Vormir to claim it.
Clint and Natasha race for the cliff; a soul is still the price.
